notes.title: Behemoth Interactive Launched. Let's celebrate with a FREE game. 🍾
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/d342f0187206fc6cf07c51e15d13729bb2834374.gif[/img]

Last week, we released our first game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825620/Blank_Frame]Blank Frame[/url]. You were thousands to experience it and rated the game positive.

🙏🏻 [b]YOU HAVE SPOKEN. LORD BEHEMOTH GRACE YOU.[/b] 🙏🏻

To thank you, we decided to do something: Releasing a game next month and for FREE. 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897530/Meat_Saw/

Amy Chambers, a young woman on her way to the Black Ridge Mountains to meet with her friends for a weekend of camping will soon find that the forest holds more than just a good time for her and her friends. The saw beckons and it must feed.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41118200/dc7b2bfef87fe2995926aba94297eefaa0c2d462.gif[/img]
Survive the horrors that await you in Meat Saw, while being stalked by a relentless AI hellbent on trying to end your life in a gruesome manner.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897530/Meat_Saw/]Download Meat Saw for FREE on March 11th. Wishlist Now. 🧠[/url]
